examples.explanation: Overlapping blocks merge into one silhouette that dips to 0 at 12, resumes at 15 and ends at 24.
The blocks touch and share one height, so the outline is flat from 0 to 5.
A single block rises to 1 between 1 and 2.

hints: Turn every building into two events (an opening and a closing) and sweep x from left to right.
Keep the active heights in a structure that yields the current maximum and supports removals, such as a balanced tree of height counts.
Emit a key point whenever the maximum changes; process all events sharing one x before deciding.
Adaptation: the nested input maps to int_array_2d and the nested output maps to int_list_2d in this judge.
title: 334. The Skyline Problem
